correctness.rationale: C4-freeness forces every mixed maximal independent set to be one center and its d opposite-side missing neighbors; full shores A,B are other maximal sets. Inclusion-exclusion of eligible priority events yields q=dn/((n-d+1)(n+d-1)). Centered-star order certificates give equal probabilities q/(2n), with full shores each (1-q)/2. Comparing these atoms to the uniform law over 2n+2 maximal sets gives TV=n/(n+1)-q, with n=3,d=2 matching-case boundary. Exact finite recursive accepted-set distributions verified 44 tested model/atom instances. This is the all-graph proof, not an inference from tests.
